steps.text: Passive poison effect deals large damage and significantly reduces enemy damage. Pike has good attack range — always try to flank.
X-move and press V; when the auto-attack damage pop-up appears, X-move and press V again to cancel the tail end of the auto-attack animation.

The auto-attack "explodes" with poison — main damage source is poison. Stack poison (roughly 4-5 auto-attacks), then back off for a few seconds and re-engage. No need to perma-front-line during blob fights.
